limits: Literal aggregates; provider request and candidate-attempt denominators are not measured.
No raw messages, inputs or credentials retained.
Header-profile and request-shape rows are paired diagnostics for one HTTP rejection, not independent attempts.
Current HTTP diagnostics omit Retry-After and failure ownership; no absence-of-hint, concurrency-limit, hard-quota, or successful-fallback claim follows from them.
Literal error classes examine only the error payload after the error= marker; remaining errors are not classified.
